title: Nashville Puppet and Sightseeing Tour
includes: Entertainment with Experienced Storyteller and Puppeteer
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Want to tour downtown Nashville but dread the thought of a lengthy history lesson? Maybe you are looking for less "party", but more fun?

Nashville Puppet & Sightseeing Tour is an experience where fun and history come alive - guided by a our bright, sunny, and incredibly entertain puppet named Cornbread!

- Unique Experience: This isn’t just any tour; it’s an interactive, puppet-led journey that entertains with engaging stories rather than just rattling off boring facts and dates.

- Family-Friendly Fun: Our tour is designed for both adults and children, ensuring everyone has a great time. It’s the perfect outing for the whole family.

- Live Entertainment: Cornbread sings, tells stories, and brings Nashville’s history to life with humor and charm, leaving everyone smiling.

Special Offer for Families:
We know that those little ones are just along for the ride. That’s why children 5 and under are always free! Bring the whole family and enjoy your time together.
